crossRefs.note: Then Peter answered, “Behold, we have left everything, and followed you. What then will we have?”
But Peter answered him, “Even if all will be made to stumble because of you, I will never be made to stumble.”
But he spoke all the more, “If I must die with you, I will not deny you.” They all said the same thing.

people.name: Peter
people.line: Apostle of Jesus, leader in the early church

translations.web: Peter answered him and said, “Lord, if it is you, command me to come to you on the waters.”
translations.bsb: “Lord, if it is You,” Peter replied, “command me to come to You on the water.”
translations.kjv: And Peter answered him and said, Lord, if it be thou, bid me come unto thee on the water.
translations.asv: And Peter answered him and said, Lord, if it be thou, bid me come unto the upon the waters.
